# Workstation NL arms pin values the app has since changed

## Context

#17844 owns the dock Neural Link battery's evidence. Its census at dev@cce07cdade (2026-09-13, runId `17844-census-cce07cdade`: 276 tests, 231 passed, 38 red, 7 skipped) still lists two arms that fail at their first assertion because the spec pins a value the Workstation deliberately changed after the spec was written. Two more arms in the same file joined them once #18648 landed after the census head. None is a product defect, and while each pinned value fails, every later assertion in its arm goes unexercised.

## The Problem

| arm (census title) | assertion | the spec expects | the app has | since |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `workstation/WorkstationPerspectivesNL › … › the store-backed perspective chain returns the exact baseline after a disruption` | `WorkstationPerspectivesNL.spec.mjs:77–82`, "precondition: the workspace boots with a committed left-edge extent" | `0.2` | `0.11`, the shipped left edge (`apps/workstation/tour/denseWorkstation.mjs:50`) | #17869 (film-stage density, 2026-08-30); the precondition landed a day earlier in #17845 |
| `workstation/WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL › … › A and its pop-out share one Group, B shares only the app name, and reloading A moves one generation and touches nothing else` | `WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL.spec.mjs:551–555`, "the vessel carries a slot of A's Group, never the URL" | `workspaceKey` matching `/^popup:/`, the engine default (`src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs:919`) | `"workstation-vessel:feed"`: the Workstation answers `tearOutWorkspaceKey` with its vessel document key (`apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs:125`) | #18383 (2026-09-06); diagnosed as a two-prefix disagreement by @neo-opus-vega on 2026-09-10 |
| `workstation/WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL › … › cold active selection hydrates keyed truth, survives popup refusal and F5, and saves another cold round-trip` · `… › a stale popup arriving first cannot choose a cold topology and the root can explicitly select the other saved layout` | `expectColdTopology`, `WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL.spec.mjs:194`, "cold truth includes the auxiliary placement participant" | the Group snapshot's participants are exactly the workspace documents plus `placementHints` | the same plus `$perspective:workstation-main: {name: 'shipped'}`, the identity participant of a declaring host | #18648 (2026-09-13, after the census head); measured on this branch at 1874378cd4 |

The perspectives arm also fails identically in a separate control run at dev@cce07cdade, so neither census red belongs to a later change. *(Amended 2026-09-13 at implementation: the third row was added when the topology-groups file ran whole on the merged head.)*

## The Architectural Reality

- `WorkstationPerspectivesNL`'s own docblock says "the baseline is read live, so the spec pins restore-fidelity, not the demo's initial layout". The `0.2` precondition is the one line that contradicts it: the arm's restore assertions already compare against the live `baselineLeftExtent`.
- `tearOutWorkspaceKey` is a consumer seam. The engine mints `popup:<item>` by default, and the Workstation's own key is one of the product reasons the #18304 seam account records. An assertion written against the engine default does not hold on a consumer that answers the seam.
- A declaring host's Group carries an identity participant beside its documents (ADR 0029 §2.1's accepted-write identity). The Workstation became a declaring host with #18648, and every other e2e assertion on that snapshot indexes a single participant key, so `expectColdTopology`'s whole-set equality is the only one it changes.
- All of these are `neuralLink`-fixture specs: ignored without `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT`, and run in no CI workflow. Evidence is a local run against the external Brain runtime.

## The Fix

1. `WorkstationPerspectivesNL.spec.mjs:77–82`: assert the precondition the arm needs rather than a layout constant. The boot document commits a numeric left extent, and it differs from the `0.32` the disruption applies, so restore-fidelity stays non-vacuous.
2. `WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL.spec.mjs:554`: expect the key the Workstation mints for the popped-out Feed pane, `workstation-vessel:feed`, in place of `/^popup:/`.
3. `expectColdTopology`: expect the declared perspective identity, `$perspective:workstation-main: {name: 'shipped'}`, beside the documents and placement hints.
4. Run both spec files whole (the census traps: never a `--grep`'d arm that has predecessors in its file), with `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT`, at the PR head.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The store-backed perspective chain arm pins no Workstation layout constant; its precondition proves a committed left extent that the disruption changes.
- [ ] The Topology Groups arm expects the vessel key the Workstation mints for the popped-out pane.
- [ ] The cold-topology helper expects the declared perspective identity beside the documents and placement hints.
- [ ] Both spec files run whole at the PR head with the external Brain runtime; the PR reports each arm's result (a local receipt: no CI workflow runs these specs).
- [ ] Any assertion that fails once its pinned value stops masking it is fixed test-only in the same PR or split into its own leaf linked from #17844, never left unreported.
- [ ] #17844's current-state block no longer lists these arms as unowned.

## Out of Scope

- The extent, the vessel key and the identity participant themselves: all are intended product values.
- The other census reds; #17844 dispositions them.

Decision Record impact: none (test expectations only).
